% ================= PROFILE =================
\needspace{3\baselineskip}
\cvsection{Profile}
Postdoctoral researcher (PhD, Applied Mathematics and Computer Science) specializing in statistical and machine-learning modeling of registry-scale health \& behavior data, and in the robustness, and stability assessment of AI systems. Investigated transformer-based systems for nation-scale health/socioeconomic trajectory prediction (\href{https://life2vec.dk}{life2vec}, trained on national registry and electronic health records), veracity probing of LLMs and multi-agent LLM simulation (CoevolveSim), with end-to-end Python experience from data extraction and cleaning to modeling and interpretability analysis. Works across multidisciplinary teams and mentors graduate researchers in interpretable ML and AI auditing.

\textbf{Areas of interest:} population-scale health \& behavior modeling, explainable AI \& AI auditing, bias \& robustness assessment, transformer architectures, agent-based simulation, evaluation of predictive models.

\needspace{3\baselineskip}
\cvsection{Education}

\entry{Technical University of Denmark}{PhD, Applied Mathematics and Computer Science}{2020--2024}{Copenhagen, Denmark}
\begin{itemize}
  \item Dissertation: \textit{Life Trajectories as Symbolic Language: Exploring Human Behaviour with Language Models}
  \item Committee: S{\o}ren Hauberg (chair), Mads Nielsen, Arkadiusz Stopczynski
\end{itemize}

\entry{Technical University of Denmark}{MSc, Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence}{2018--2020}{Copenhagen, Denmark}
\begin{itemize}
  \item Thesis (Collaboration with Novo Nordisk): \textit{Analyzing Health Data Records Using Neural Networks}
  \item Thesis Advisors: Sune Lehmann (DTU) and Adam Lenart (Novo Nordisk)
\end{itemize}

\entry{Aalto University}{Visiting Student, Digital Ethics \& Statistical Natural Language Processing}{2021}{Helsinki, Finland}

% ================= RESEARCH EXPERIENCE =================
\needspace{3\baselineskip}
\cvsection{Research Experience}

\entry{Northeastern University}{\textbf{Postdoctoral Research Associate} | Mentor: Tina Eliassi-Rad}{May 2024--present}{Boston, USA}
\begin{itemize}
  \item Developed LLM probing frameworks for knowledge representation and belief stability~\href{https://github.com/carlomarxdk/trilemma-of-truth}{[sAwMIL]}.
  \item Designed a multi-agent framework (using R and Python) to study opinion dynamics in networks of LLM agents~\href{https://github.com/carlomarxdk/coevolve-sim}{[CoevolveSim]}.
  \item Supervised graduate researchers in interpretable machine learning and LLM auditing; coordinated research on multi-agent interactions.
  \item Presented projects at the NeurIPS Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop, IC2S2, and NEMI Workshop.
\end{itemize}

\entry{Technical University of Denmark \& University of Copenhagen}{\textbf{PhD Student \& Research Assistant} | Advisors: Sune Lehmann, Lars Kai Hansen}{Sep 2020--Apr 2024}{Copenhagen, Denmark}
\begin{itemize}
  \item Led modeling of nation-scale socioeconomic and health trajectories using transformer-based models~\href{https://life2vec.dk}{[life2vec]}.
  \item Developed and evaluated life-outcome prediction models, with emphasis on interpretability.
  \item Taught and developed course materials for a graduate-level course in Social Network Science.
  \item Invited talks at MIT, University of Oxford, NordicAI and Complexity Science Hub.
\end{itemize}

\entry{Statistics Denmark, Data Science Lab}{\textbf{Guest Researcher}}{Sep 2020--Apr 2024}{Copenhagen, Denmark}
\begin{itemize}
  \item Collaborated with economists and social scientists to conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses of demographic and socioeconomic patterns in observational registry data.
  \item Led modeling of large-scale longitudinal datasets.
\end{itemize}

\entry{Network Science Institute, Northeastern University}{\textbf{Visiting PhD Student}}{Sep 2022--Feb 2023}{Boston, USA}
\begin{itemize}
  \item Analyzed ethical and societal risks of deep learning applied to socioeconomic data.
  \item Investigated methods for enhancing transparency and fairness in algorithmic systems.
\end{itemize}

\entry{Novo Nordisk, R\&D (Real World Evidence)}{\textbf{Researcher (Student Assistant)}}{Sep 2019--Apr 2020}{Copenhagen, Denmark}
\begin{itemize}
  \item Conducted research on predictive models for medical adherence using large-scale Electronic Health Records (EHRs), addressing missing data and selection bias in the observational cohort.
  \item Developed hierarchical attention-based neural models for health outcome prediction.
  \item Led preprocessing and integration of behavioral and clinical data sources.
\end{itemize}

  {{- $links := slice }}
  {{- with $p.Params.doi }}{{ $links = $links | append (partial "cv/link.tex" (dict "url" (printf "https://doi.org/%s" .) "label" "DOI")) }}{{ end }}
  {{- with $p.Params.pub_link }}
    {{- if in . "arxiv.org" }}{{ $links = $links | append (partial "cv/link.tex" (dict "url" . "label" "arXiv")) }}
    {{- else if not $p.Params.doi }}{{ $links = $links | append (partial "cv/link.tex" (dict "url" . "label" (cond (in . "dtu.dk") "DTU" "Link"))) }}
    {{- end }}
  {{- end }}
  {{- range $p.Params.resources }}
    {{- if index . "on-cv" }}
      {{- $name := .name }}
      {{- with findRESubmatch `^\((.+)\)\s*(.+)$` $name 1 }}{{ $name = printf "%s %s" (index (index . 0) 2) (index (index . 0) 1) }}{{ end }}
      {{- $links = $links | append (partial "cv/link.tex" (dict "url" .link "label" $name)) }}
    {{- end }}
  {{- end }}
\pubentry{ {{- $authors -}} }
  { {{- $p.Date.Year -}} }{ {{- $title -}} }{ {{- $venue -}} }
  { {{- delimit $links " " -}} }
{{ end }}
